description: This Java class 'EmailCampaignValidator' provides validation logic for email campaign data in the Fineract platform. It supports creating, updating, previewing, activating, and closing email campaigns by validating JSON input data against expected parameters and business rules.

classes.name: EmailCampaignValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating JSON data related to email campaigns in the Fineract system. It ensures required fields are present and conform to expected formats during creation, update, preview, activation, and closure operations.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a new email campaign, checking for required fields such as campaign name, type, business rule ID, email subject, message, and parameters.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON data for updating an existing email campaign, ensuring essential parameters are correctly provided.

methods.name: validatePreviewMessage
methods.description: Validates JSON input for previewing an email campaign message, verifying presence of parameters relevant for message rendering.

methods.name: validateClosedDate
methods.description: Validates JSON data containing the closure date of a campaign to ensure it is provided and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateActivation
methods.description: Validates JSON for activating a campaign, specifically checking for a valid activation date.

methods.name: validateClosure
methods.description: Validates JSON for closing a campaign, focusing on ensuring a valid closure date.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Utility method that throws validation exception if any data validation errors were collected during validation checks.
